description: Lists the approval queue (filled by queue_adjustment; propose_next_week and adjust_guide hand back a `queuePayload` for it) from the local file only: never contacts Suunto, needs no credentials, writes nothing. Each item: { id, kind, status ('pending' | 'expired' | 'approved' | 'rejected'), forDate, source, createdAt, expiresAt, reasons, resolution: { decision, at, note, pushed } | null }. pending: waiting for the user; expired: not decided before expiresAt, can no longer be approved (it can still be rejected); approved / rejected: decided. `status` filters ('pending', 'expired', 'done' = approved or rejected, 'all' default); with `id` the one item in full: its `payload` and `call` (the DRY-RUN form, push_week_plan with dryRun true: never a ready real push) and `howToPush`. Output: { now, counts: { pending, expired, approved, rejected }, items, notes }. Read-only.

id.description: One approval's id, e.g. 'a3': returns it in full with its payload and the exact call.

status.description: Which items to list: pending, expired, done (approved or rejected) or all (default).

name: list_approvals
title: List the approval queue (pending, expired, done)
